nodes.name: One-pot salt-templating synthesis of MgOx/MoOy-Ru
nodes.procedure: A mixture of metal acetylacetonate and potassium bromide (KBr) as a structure-directing agent was directly annealed in air. During the annealed process, the Ru3+ can catalyze the carbonization of acetylacetonate anion into carbon through oxygen desorption, and thus Ru3+ can be subsequently reduced to Ru by the generated carbon.

nodes.description: Electrocatalytic HER performance in 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: the MgOx/MoOy-Ru metallene exhibits an impressive catalytic activity with a low overpotential of 8.5 mV at 10 mAcm−2... delivers a high mass activity of 2.91 Amg−1 at an overpotential of 100 mV, 15.3 and 3.4 times larger than those of Ru metallene (0.19 Amg−1) and commercial Pt/C (0.87 Amg−1)... Tafel slope is lowered to 33.3 mVdec−1 suggesting that the rate-determining step has been changed from the Heyrovsky step... to the Tafel step.

The HER polarization curves display that the MgOx/MoOy-Ru metallene exhibits... a low overpotential... much lower than those of the Ru metallene (88.7 mV)... mass activity... 15.3 and 3.4 times larger than those of Ru metallene (0.19 A mg−1).

The HER polarization curves display... much lower than those of the Ru metallene (88.7 mV) and commercial Pt/C (33.6 mV)... mass activity... larger than those of Ru metallene (0.19 A mg−1) and commercial Pt/C (0.87 A mg−1).

nodes.description: Anion Exchange Membrane Water Electrolyzer (AEMWE) performance
nodes.source_text: the MgOx/MoOy-Ru-based anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer can achieve a high current density of 100 mA cm−2 at a remarkably low cell voltage of 1.55 V, and exhibit excellent durability of over 60 h at a current density of 500 mA cm−2.
the cell voltage of the MEA based on MgOx/MoOy-Ru metallene || IrO2 is 1.55 V, significantly lower than that of the commercial Pt/C || IrO2-based MEA (1.60 V).
